title: Khadgar, Garona, and the Ring
summary: On alternate Draenor, Khadgar's legendary-ring campaign intersects with Garona's control and Gul'dan's Shadow Council.
opening: An assassin's attack revealed another will behind it. Khadgar's search for the truth carried the campaign deeper into the Shadow Council's plans.
reviewNote: This is alternate Draenor. Verify the full ring questline and do not merge this Garona's sequence with main-timeline history.
